title: Record activity panel renders an empty list with no message when GET sys_activity answers 403 (hosted AI-app members), so a permission wall reads as 'no activity'
body:
From seat `repo:cloud#1` R43 (session `session_01YSygzqVmrY31BnZge8KDo6`), found through objectstack-ai/cloud#2485. For triage: the fix lands in the record page's activity panel (the plugin-detail / app-shell feed). This seat does not produce `domain:*`.

## Defect (measured on the cloud#2485 card, 2026-09-30, journey round 3)

An invited org member (non-admin) opens a record of an owner's AI-built app. The record page's activity panel calls `GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?…`, gets back **403**, and **renders an empty list with no message**. The member cannot tell "no activity" apart from "not allowed to see activity". Quote from the card: 「动态流 sys_activity 对成员 403 时，界面只显示空列表，没有任何提示」.

This stays true after objectstack-ai/cloud#2495. cloud withholds `sys_activity` read from members until the platform adds a parent-record read gate (objectstack card filed in the same batch). Until then the 403 is the intended answer, and the panel must say so.

## Acceptance

1. On 403 (and on any other refused read), the activity panel shows a localized "no permission to view activity" state, visually distinct from the empty state.
2. The empty state (200 with zero rows) is unchanged.
3. A component test covers both states.

Related: objectstack-ai/cloud#2485 · objectui#11035 (a different feed defect on `sys_activity` rows).
